messages.subject: Pinnacle House, Leeds - heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia,

Further to our call, I attach the draft heads of terms for the letting of Floors 4-5 Pinnacle House. Key points: 15-year term from 29 September, headline rent £612,500 pa (£32.50 psf), 9 months rent free, tenant break at year 7, rent deposit of six months' rent, contracted out of the 1954 Act. Grateful for your comments.

Best
Elena

messages.subject: RE: Pinnacle House, Leeds - heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Thank you. Brookmere are broadly content but have asked us to push on three points at the lease stage: a shorter break notice period (they would like six months rather than nine), a longer rent-suspension period and a softer forfeiture trigger. The commercial terms (rent, rent free, term) are agreed. We'll deal with the detail on the lease mark-up.

Nadia
